 Kinolune OS 0.1.0 - Installer                                      Step 2 of 7

 System disk
 Choose a disk. EVERYTHING ON IT WILL BE ERASED. Other disks are not touched.

 >   Samsung 990 PRO 1TB  1.0 TB  NVMe      /dev/nvme0n1  S/N ...456X
     Samsung 870 EVO 1TB  1.0 TB  SATA SSD  /dev/sda      S/N ...321A
     WD WD40EFRX-68N32N0  4.0 TB  SATA HDD  /dev/sdb      S/N ...CDEF
     WD WD40EFRX-68N32N0  4.0 TB  SATA HDD  /dev/sdc      S/N ...DCBA

 the disk looks empty: /dev/nvme0n1

 Not offered:
   - SanDisk Ultra 31 GB /dev/sdd: the installer boots from it
   - virtual devices (loop, zram): 4








 Up/Down: disk  Enter: choose  R: rescan  Esc: back  Ctrl+C: exit
